_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Find open class action settlements you may claim...

description: Use this when someone asks which class action settlements they can claim, or whether a purchase, a data breach letter or a service they used has a settlement. Pass where (US state or 'US') and bought_or_used in plain words; both are optional. Only US settlements are covered today: pass the person's real place, and a UK or Australian place returns not_covered_yet. Returns open US settlements with who can claim, the payout as stated, the deadline and days left, the official claim link and the source page with an as_of date. Facts come only from court-approved settlement sites. Show not_legal_advice and safety as given. It never files a claim.

bought_or_used.description: Brands, products or services they bought or used, in plain words ('iPhone 16, Kroger pharmacy, rent an apartment'). Leave out to list every open settlement

where.description: Where the person lives: a US state name or code ('Texas', 'TX'), 'New York City', or 'US'. Leave out for the whole US

name: find_settlements

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

bought_or_used.description: What the rows were matched to; null when every open settlement is listed

data_as_of.description: When the daily page check last ran (UTC); null before the first run

matched.description: Rows that matched before the limit

not_legal_advice.description: Show this line to the person

open_for_you.description: Open settlements for this place before matching

as_of.description: The last day the row was confirmed against its source, YYYY-MM-DD

checked_by.description: How the row is kept current: a daily page check, or read by hand

claim_url.description: The official claim link on the settlement site

court.description: The court or agency named on the official site; null when the page does not name it plainly

days_left.description: The number of whole days after today until the deadline, in US Pacific time. 0 means today is the last day

deadline_note.description: A condition on the deadline, such as 'or until the fund runs out'

lives_in.description: Where class members must live: 'Anywhere in the US' or the state

needs_notice.description: True when the company's records decide who is in the class and those people got a notice. If there's no notice, the person most likely can't file

payout.description: What a claim can pay, as the official site states it

source_url.description: The official page the deadline was read from

who.description: Who the official site says can claim, in short

safety.description: Show this line to the person

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

where.description: The place the rows were filtered for

title: Find open class action settlements you may claim
